value.rationale: A sharp family-wide single-crossing rule resolves whether mean reproduction and offspring overdispersion can reverse rankings of early-epidemic establishment risk as uniform contact retention changes. It disallows additional reversals, provides the exact crossing equation and a realizable p=5/9 example. This is a motivated risk-comparison structural theorem, not simply computing one extinction root.
